representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated production-like Supabase branch required before promotion

rowCountQueries: select venue_id, count(*) from public.venue_booking_requests group by venue_id order by venue_id
select venue_id, count(*) from public.venue_manual_transactions group by venue_id order by venue_id
select min(date), max(date), count(*) from public.venue_analytics
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates the recorded-money ledger only when absent, replaces two analytics routines, upserts at most one venue_analytics row per Venue/day with real-source activity in the trailing 30 days, and preserves traffic columns not owned by this rollup

execution.resumeStrategy: Transactional re-issue or an additive forward-fix after isolated rehearsal; the required immediate backfill fails the transaction instead of being reduced to a warning
execution.idempotency: The ledger uses CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS; functions use CREATE OR REPLACE; the rollup upserts the existing venue/date key; the affected-row accumulator uses a separate ROW_COUNT target; the cron job is replaced by exact name when available

quarantine.strategy: Do not infer tenant ownership; stop and quarantine unresolved rows before any backfill

constraints: venue_manual_transactions enforces positive recorded amounts plus income/expense and completed/pending/cancelled vocabularies; RLS is enabled with direct client access denied by the absence of client policies
get_venue_dashboard_stats rejects callers without verified Venue operator access
refresh_venue_analytics_daily is executable only by service_role
rollup window is restricted to 1 through 400 days and writes one row per venue/date conflict key
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Fresh-chain rehearsal, operator/non-operator dashboard negatives, authenticated rollup denial, source-versus-rollup count and total parity, 30-day backfill proof, and second-run convergence

recovery.rollback: Prefer flag-off rollback; use an additive compensating migration for persisted schema changes
recovery.forwardFix: Ship a later additive migration after preserving unresolved records and evidence

queries: Read-only object, row-count, RLS, grant, constraint, and advisor checks must be captured
